programme.title: Sicily With Aldo & Enzo

programme.title: Wild Travels

programme.title: Neven’s Irish Seafood Trails

programme.title: Toque 12

We see him with Chef Phil in the working kitchen cooking some Marini signatures and later at the bar delving into some mysterious cocktails.

programme.title: Todo Bien

They also sprinkle in tips for traveling in Baja to help anyone curious about travel south of the border.

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E01
programme.desc: Sail to 6 Caribbean islands in 6 days. Explore the sites of St. Vincent, Bequia, Canouan, Tobago Cays, Petite St. Vincent and Union Island. Cook-up a delectable meal, release endangered Hawksbill turtles, catch a Mahi Mahi, and so much more.

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E02
programme.desc: Canada’s East Coast is known for having the highest tides in the world. The Travel Guy walks on the sea bed as the tide rises and falls 12 metres (40 feet). Ride a tidal bore, explore Canada’smost iconic ship and visit with the 78th Highland Regiment.

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E03
programme.desc: "Explore the mystical Giant’s Causeway, castles and Belfast home of the famed ship, Titanic. The Travel Guy has a pint or two in the world’s most beautiful bar, goes back in time at the Ulster Folk Museum and gets into shape by trying a sport called “Bouldering," learns to play the Bodhran, explores castles and gets told a fairy tale...and so much more that is not mentioned in this description. Let's just say that he did not miss a beat on this adventure.

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E04
programme.desc: The land of waterfalls, glaciers, volcanoes and Viking horses running wild. The Travel Guy takes a dip in the theraputic water of the blue lagoon, snowmobiles across a glacier, boils an egg in the world’s original Geysir, checks out seals at Diamond Beach and even eats rotten shark, sheep’s balls and a sheep’s head - yum, yum.

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E05
programme.desc: "The Travel Guy experiences best shark dive in the world to see the big boys of the ocean (the Tiger Shark) with no cage. On land, he marvels at fire walkers, visits dramatic sand dunes, participates in the kava ceremony, tackles the challenging rapids of the Luva river and explores a few villages."

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E06
programme.desc: The Travel Guy meets local island workers and helps them catch food for dinner. He is in the water catching the ingredients for a fabulous feast that evening, he dives one of the top 10 sites in the world called "The Chimneys" and trains a beach crab so he can enter a weekly crab race - great fun for everyone – including the crabs.

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E07
programme.desc: The Travel Guy stimulates his mind with Brains Beer. He visits a few notable castles and an architectural marvel called Portmeirion. He participates in an adrenalin-pumping sport called coasteering and attempts to break the world bog snorkelling record. The Travel Guy can’t sing but visits a choir rehearsal that shakes the auditorium walls.

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E08
programme.desc: The Travel Guy discovers America’s oldest city and The Fountain Of Youth. He relives history and becomes the flag bearer at the Castillo de San Marcos Fort, visits the world’s first “oceanarium” and gets a painting lesson from a dolphin. He also meets and feeds the local wildlife-very large alligators.

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E09
programme.desc: "This island is famous for its mythological and Biblical occurrences. The Travel Guy visits the tombs of the Kings, the birthplace of the Aphrodite and the tomb of Lazarus, who was once raised from the dead. He dives underwater in search of centuries old pottery, cooks-up a traditional Meze meal and explores the island’s many other attractions."

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E10
programme.desc: "The American Civil War started here. The Travel Guy visits America’s premier military college and is taught rifle drills, he sets out on a midnight ghost hunt and enters one of America’s most haunted building. He explores the historic streets, a famous battleship, a coldwar submarine and a world-renowned plantation."

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E11
programme.desc: "The Travel Guy goes scuba diving from various shore locations around the island. He cooks up a culinary storm using a Wahoo fish and descends underground to try cave snorkeling, then paddles his way through mangroves and makes many friends with the residents of the Donkey sanctuary, yes, donkeys!"

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E12
programme.desc: "It’s all uphill for The Travel Guy as he takes Gondola lifts to the summits of breath-taking locations on the Swiss Alps. He learns how to make and play the traditional Alphorn, catches a rides on the world’s steepest cogwheel train and gets his hands (and mouth) on the world famous Swiss chocolate."

programme.title: The Travel Guy S02E13
programme.desc: "The Travel Guy takes in the Yukon wildlife, and then cooks up Moose Ribs in a Chocolate Sauce to perfection (at least in his mind). He bumpes into “Caveman Bill” who lives in a cave, gets an aerial view of the world’s largest non-polar ice fields, mushes a team of dogs across a frozen lake and burns away his winter blues."

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In Portofino, we’ll be shown how to make the authentic version of pesto alla Genovese, by chef Corrado at the legendary Hotel Splendido. We will then visit the Canale bakery to see how they make the famous local bread called focaccia; and after that, we will meet up with my dear friend Nina on the yacht in Portofino’s iconic harbour, which is where we met over 25 years ago. She wants to show us how to make a couple of delicious dishes, in the galley.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Chef Massimo Capra meets chef Uri Navon who’s restaurant islocated in a Kosher neighbourhood, yet serves none kosher food. He connects with Chef Moshe Basson who is very popular in Jerusalem. Chef Massimo visits a mountain cheese maker, navigates the market vendor stalls, tastes everything he can and finds the two ingredients he needs, the tahini and meat for his meal. He does find the time to explore a few attractions along the way.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Arriving in Tel Aviv, the culinary centre of Israel, Chef Massimo decides to have a relaxing evening dinner, instead, he is treated to an eye opening cooking demonstration by a very animated chef. In the morning he visits Tel Aviv's magnificent beach waterfront then meets up with Chef Oved Alfia and together cook-up a delectable morning treat. From here he heads back to Jerusalem to meet up with Chef Moche Basson to grab ingredients at the Old Jerusalem Market....It's a real treat.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Chef Massimo Capra meets chef Sheldon Fonseca of a very exclusive resort high above the town of Vevey. Chef Sheldon sends Massimo on a gathering spree that takes him into local restaurants, vendors located along the spectacular Alp mountain trail from Chef Sheldon's restaurant. When Massimo has completed the gathering of ingredients, they prepare the dish and enjoy their creation above the clouds and overlooking a breath-taking view of Lake Geneva below.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Newfoundland, Canada is blessed with fish, wildlife, post card like scenery and great people. Chef Massimo Capra finally catches big fish that will be on the menu when he teams up with chef Nathan Orton and together prepare a meal known locally as a “Boil Up”- it’s a Newfoundland tradition. They invite a few friends and cook over an open fire and camping stoves on a small island. Friends just pull ip in their boats and join in the meal.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Chef Massimo Capra visits Playa Del Carmen to experiencing a resort with its own hydroponics greenhouses. Fresh daily vegetables and spices are delivered to the resort chefs along with the local fresh catch of the day. Massimo experiences resort gourmet cooking and how to make authentic Mexican food and sauces. His Chef have set up a large grill on the beach and have the catch of the day brought in to cook up an amazing meal, complete with cerveza...OLE!

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: A resort offering gourmet fare needs to be explored in its entirety. Chef Massimo Capra continues to meet-up with resort chefs, but first he explores Playa Del Carmen and get authentic Tacos from a street vendor, then of course a beach massauge before he goes back on the resort to continue his investigation of great gourmet restort fare. This time he is making traditional and authentic Tortillas. He also wonders how they make their pasta so he connects with an italian/mexican chef at the resort and when two italians get together, they create a pasta masterpiece....

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Chef Massimo Capra loves big game and Yukon, Canada has some of the biggest game in the world. He meets up with Michele Ginest, who is a foremost expert in cooking big game. He get a lesson from a female moose hunter on moose calling and she also supplies him with the Moose meat for dinner. Chef Massimo goes out into the countryside to forage for the rest of the ingredients with Michele that include mushrooms and berries, they even go to forage at the World's smallest desert located in Yukon, Canada. The end result has to be an astonishing meal.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Chef Gerardo D’Amore connects with Ireland’s own Martin Shanahan in Kinsale (Ireland’s culinary capital). His restaurant named “Fishy Fishy’” is known by all in Ireland. The daily catch is brought from the ocean that is at the front door of his restaurant, and on to the table. Gerardo gathers the ingredients with Martin and visit the local farmer, markets and casts out to sea. They even get the famous Irish whiskey and possibly do a little too much sampling at the distillery.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Chef Gerardo D'Amore experiences a tasteful diner at 39,000 feet in the air and learns that the food is prepared differently if you eat it at those hights. He visits the Lufthansa Airlines kitchen to learn more and then to Titisee in the Black Forest region. Known for the amazing scenery, theBlack Forest Cake and farm harvested trout, he connects with chef Andreas to prepare an untraditional meal with a German twist.

programme.title: Gourmet Escapes
programme.desc: Chef Gerardo D’Amore visits two tropical islands where the menu features anything that comes from the ocean. Three chefs help him understand the Island style cooking, one modern and the others, a more traditional style.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this, the final episode, we sail along the French Riviera and catch up with some of the people and places we know and love. This region is particularly dear to Patrick; he was born in Marseille and spent all of his childhood summers on this coast. First, we’ll visit St Tropez, including the iconic Club 55; then we’ll take you to Antibes and to a couple of nearby villages, St Paul de Vence and Biot. Each has a restaurant which we count among our favourites, and they have two things in common – traditional Provençal food… and art, which in each case is largely its raison d’être.
